name: FunctionSynthesis.k
model:
fun mystery(x:Int) : Int


req mystery(0) = 0

req mystery(1) = 1

req mystery(2) = 4

req mystery(3) = 9

class Query {
  answer4:Int
  answer5:Int

  req answer4 = mystery(4)

  req answer5 = mystery(5)
}

q:Query
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (q Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Query (mk-Query (answer4 Int)(answer5 Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Query (sel-Query Query))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Query ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Query (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Query ((this Ref)) Query
  (sel-Query (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Query ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Query this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.q: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!q ((this Ref)) Ref
  (q (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Query:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Query.answer4: ---

(define-fun Query!answer4 ((this Ref)) Int
  (answer4 (deref-Query this))
)

; --- getters for Query.answer5: ---

(define-fun Query!answer5 ((this Ref)) Int
  (answer5 (deref-Query this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Methods for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

(declare-fun TopLevelDeclarations.mystery (Ref Int) Int)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!mystery ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery this x)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Query (TopLevelDeclarations!q this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery this 0) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery this 1) 1)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery this 2) 4)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery this 3) 9)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Query:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Query Query)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Query.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Query!answer4 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery 0 4))
)

(assert (! (Query.inv1 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Query.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Query!answer5 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!mystery 0 5))
)

(assert (! (Query.inv2 1) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Query const-1-Query))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-Query () Query
  (mk-Query 6 7))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 1) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 2) 4))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (answer5 (sel-Query (select heap 1))) (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 5)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (answer4 (sel-Query (select heap 1))) (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 4)))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 0) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations.mystery 0 3) 9))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (q (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Query a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-Query (mk-Query 6 7))))
(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.mystery ((x!0 Int) (x!1 Int)) Int
  (ite (and (= x!0 0) (= x!1 1)) 1
  (ite (and (= x!0 0) (= x!1 2)) 4
  (ite (and (= x!0 0) (= x!1 3)) 9
  (ite (and (= x!0 0) (= x!1 4)) 6
  (ite (and (= x!0 0) (= x!1 5)) 7
    0))))))
